deployments_detail.use: ChatGPT Enterprise deployed to ~35,000 Mitsubishi UFJ Bank employees for document preparation, research/analysis and customer-service support, as part of becoming an 'AI-native' organization. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise)]

Investment in and adoption of LayerX AI (Bakuraku / Ai Workforce) to automate back-office operations such as RFPs, sales pitches and customer document cross-checking. [LayerX (Bakuraku / Ai Workforce)]

MUFG Investor Services uses NLP to automatically extract data from capital statements, capital calls and distribution notices, replacing manual keying and enabling document summarization/sentiment analysis. [none]

Adoption of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform as MUFG Bank's next-generation data & AI foundation (supporting ~30,000 employees) for fraud detection, risk management, marketing and generative-AI-based data analytics/AI agents. [Databricks]
Internal generative AI platform "AI-bow" (アイボウ), used across 110+ operations
ChatGPT Enterprise rollout to ~35,000 employees from Jan 2026 (docs, research, customer service, analysis)
Three-year partnership deploying Sakana AI reasoning models for internal decision-support workflows and automated creation of banking documents. [Sakana AI]
Sakana AI 'AI Loan Expert' for corporate credit approvals — data analysis, financial simulations and drafting of approval documents; PoC completed and real-world branch testing underway. [Sakana AI]
System combining satellite imagery and AI to inspect real estate used as loan collateral for small-business loans, replacing on-site property inspections. [none]
deployments_detail.value: ~10,000 staff hours saved annually (projected); launch planned FY2027

deployments_detail.use: Integration of MUFG banking apps with OpenAI's 'Apps in ChatGPT' so retail customers can consult ChatGPT about household budgeting and asset management; first Japanese company to use the service. [OpenAI (ChatGPT / Apps in ChatGPT)]

Alteryx analytics workflows in MUFG's Global Financial Crimes Division for AML/CFT transaction monitoring across NY, London, Singapore and Tokyo; automated data cleansing for suspicious-activity detection. [Alteryx]
deployments_detail.value: Data cleansing cut from ~130 hours to ~5 hours per quarterly session (96% reduction)

deployments_detail.use: Private AI adopted on MUFG's 'OCEAN' big-data platform for on-premises automatic detection and anonymization of PII/confidential information in emails, call-center logs, PDFs and chats before generative-AI analysis. [Private AI]
